summary: @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) applies CSS only when the device is in dark mode. Store the colors in custom properties, then change only the variables inside that query.
notes: The preview uses the theme your system is set to. Change your system setting to see the other theme.
Dark mode is not just black and white swapped. The accent is a lighter blue (#8db8ef) so it stays readable on a dark background.
The input gets dark colors automatically because of the color-scheme meta tag in the HTML.
pitfall: Changing the background to dark but forgetting a color set somewhere else, such as a link color. That text ends up dark on dark and unreadable.
